description: This file defines functions and types related to configuration write permissions and scope resolution within a channel-based messaging system. It manages authorization logic, target resolution, and message formatting for denied write attempts.

methods.name: resolveChannelConfigWrites
methods.description: Determines if config writes are allowed for a specific channel and account based on configuration.

methods.name: authorizeConfigWrite
methods.description: Checks if a config write operation is authorized based on origin, target, and bypass permissions.

methods.name: resolveExplicitConfigWriteTarget
methods.description: Resolves a scope to a specific config write target (global, channel, or account).

methods.name: resolveConfigWriteTargetFromPath
methods.description: Derives a config write target from a given path array.

methods.name: canBypassConfigWritePolicy
methods.description: Determines if a message channel can bypass config write policies based on internal channel status and scopes.

methods.name: formatConfigWriteDeniedMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly message explaining why a config write was denied.
